HF dataset revision 61fc0608cfd831fcfbbaa676ebdfef0ed963eeda carries only BFCL_v3_* files; V4 items came from the pinned gorilla commit f7cf7359 via plain https with per-file sha256 recorded in selection.

Strict repo-adapter oracle (exact Unicode, exact int/float/bool, missing-or-extra fails) vs lenient upstream AST checker (case/punctuation-insensitive strings, many allowed surface forms, '' = omit optional): expected uses the first concrete form, so reported accuracies are a lower bound, not leaderboard-comparable.
Bare single user message used instead of upstream system+user split; upstream eval temperature is 0.001 vs 0.0 here (both effectively greedy).

Content-only grading: reasoning_content ignored; 2 irrelevance cases returned empty content with finish_reason=length (512-token budget exhausted by 511 reasoning tokens) and graded as no calls (pass). max_tokens=512 truncates reasoning-heavy turns.

No SerpAPI key and no live network beyond the model endpoint, so agentic/web_search categories are unavailable (excluded, never zero); retired restful/executable never reported; live/multi-turn/format_sensitivity/memory excluded from this slice by design.
